description: This file defines the ProductImageGet interface which declares methods for retrieving product images and their metadata within the CMS module of the sales manager application.

classes.name: ProductImageGet
classes.description: Interface for accessing product images, extending ImageGet, with methods to get images by various parameters.

methods.name: getProductImage (String merchantStoreCode, String productCode, String imageName)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product image based on merchant store code, product code, and image name.

methods.name: getProductImage (String merchantStoreCode, String productCode, String imageName, ProductImageSize size)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product image with a specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage (ProductImage productImage)
methods.description: Retrieves a product image based on a ProductImage object.

methods.name: getImages (Product product)
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a given product.
